name: Cube School
summary:
You are an ordinary student of school №13, but you don't know where you got yet... This school hasn't been working for a long time, and one teacher lives there..

You came to study at this school, but here's the trouble! You forgot all your textbooks in different classes And you have to stay not much longer than you planned to have time to collect all your textbooks.

But the teacher doesn't like those people who stay much longer, and he goes out to hunt you..

Hurry up and take the textbooks and leave this school!! Use all your strength, play for speed, make speeders. After all, the teacher is getting faster and faster..

Oh no! You have collected all your textbooks, now you will have to last 5 MINUTES. Hold on running away from the fast teacher, and collect coins in a dark gloomy atmosphere..

Teacher: Oh! Has anyone not finished the donut? I definitely need to eat it!
